recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆多核巨大異型細胞，有強烈的細胞膜與胞質陽性染色（圖型提示 CD30），旁邊數顆大細胞染色較弱，周圍大量小淋巴球為陰性，呈現間變型的奇異巨細胞。
features: Central giant multinucleated cell with vesicular nuclei and strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity
Adjacent large cells with weaker membranous and cytoplasmic staining
Isolated positive large cell at lower right
Background of numerous small, negative lymphocytes with dense nuclei
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled; pattern suggests CD30) shows a giant multinucleated atypical cell with strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, accompanied by a cluster of large cells with weaker staining. The background small lymphocytes are negative. This field alone resembles a Reed-Sternberg-like cell; in the context of sheets of large cells with a B-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells in cHL are CD15-positive, CD45-negative, and weakly PAX5-positive, and are isolated rather than part of sheets of CD20-positive large cells.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20-positive cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background, typically without strong CD30 expression.
ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in all tumor cells with a T-cell or null phenotype and no B-cell marker expression.
